      <div class="detail-card">
        <div class="day">Flying in</div>
        <h3>Airports</h3>
        <p>Ithaca Tompkins (ITH) and Elmira Corning (ELM) are the closest airports to the venue. Syracuse (SYR) is farther out, about ninety minutes away, but it often has more flights and lower fares.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="detail-card">
        <div class="day">Getting around</div>
        <h3>Rent a Car</h3>
        <p>Downtown Ithaca, Trumansburg, and Watkins Glen are all walkable, but the surrounding area is rural, so you may want a car to explore or to travel to the venue and the welcome party. Ubers and rideshares can be hard to find out here. There is plenty of free parking at the Inn.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="detail-card">
        <div class="day">On the day</div>
        <h3>Shuttle</h3>
        <p>We’re planning a shuttle from downtown Ithaca to the Inn before the ceremony, with two trips back at the end of the night: one around 9:30 pm and one after the reception ends at 10:30 pm. We’ll post pickup times and stops here closer to the wedding.</p>
      </div>

    </div>

  </div>
